universe_boundary: WP-007 cycle 1 inventories the bounded source universe only: the current Lovable-managed repository adopted by DEC-010, the governance document families and machine registers it contains, the application registers, the historical bootstrap and prior-repository artifacts named in WP-006 provenance, and the externally held sources declared by the owner. Nothing outside this list is claimed to be complete, and no source is opened, copied, restored, or promoted by being inventoried. Repository-resident sources are bound to commit 62ce7d3a9c305674de5bd83801af3bf5c41edf83.

records.title: Current Lovable-managed SSLS repository
records.classification_basis: DEC-010 adopts this repository as the go-forward software source of truth; DEC-014 closed WP-006 on that basis.
records.access_note: None recorded.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: It carries the executable implementation any recovered requirement must be reconciled against.
records.boundary: Current authority over software source only. It is not authority over governance decisions, gates, or external obligations.

records.title: WP-000 exposure containment and trust document family
records.classification_basis: Executed WP-000 artifacts closed by DEC-008 with residual risk accepted by DEC-009. They record what was done, not what is now required.
records.access_note: Historical evidence; content is not rewritten by this work package.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Contains the prohibited-claims and disclosure positions that later requirement extraction must not contradict.
records.boundary: Records an executed remediation pass. It is not a security, privacy, or legal determination.

records.title: WP-006 current-state SSOT and provenance document family
records.classification_basis: Closed by DEC-014. Its SSOT record is bound to an earlier commit and is superseded as a live description by the evidence pipeline.
records.access_note: Commit-bound documents are read at their recorded binding, not reinterpreted at HEAD.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Names the prior repository and bootstrap artifacts that define the outer edge of the historical universe.
records.boundary: Provenance mapping only. It does not establish that any historical requirement is still in force.

records.title: WP-037 evidence and verification pipeline document family
records.classification_basis: Closed by DEC-017 after the bounded remediation authorized by DEC-016.
records.access_note: Immutable execution evidence under evidence/ is never edited.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Defines the evidence contract any recovered requirement must be provable against.
records.boundary: Automated, point-in-time evidence. Not independent security validation.

records.recovery_relevance_reason: External obligations bound here constrain which historical requirements may be revived.
records.boundary: Planning and engineering input only. Not legal advice, certification, or proof of any obligation being met.

records.title: Canonical obligation and external-authority registers
records.classification_basis: DEC-018 closes WP-038 on these registers as the canonical obligation baseline, enforced by executing integrity tests.
records.access_note: None recorded.

records.title: Immutable evidence records
records.classification_basis: Layer A of the WP-037 pipeline: execution records are written once and never repaired, including failed and not-completed attempts.
records.access_note: Records may be added but never edited; EV-VULN is preserved verbatim as a failed attempt.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Supplies the only executed proof available for statements about past repository states.
records.boundary: Machine-executed results within their tested scope only.

records.title: Evidence baseline manifest and artifacts
records.classification_basis: Layer B is re-derived, not rebound; the manifest describes the current input sets and is replaced on every run.
records.access_note: Regenerated by `bun run evidence:run`.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Derived state; it carries no requirement text.
records.boundary: Applicability status only. Not certification or release readiness.

records.title: Application governance registers
records.classification_basis: Holds the accepted decision, finding, evidence and claim records the interface renders; owner dispositions are recorded here and nowhere else.
records.access_note: None recorded.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Every recovered requirement must be reconciled against the decisions and findings already recorded here.
records.boundary: Authority over recorded governance state only. Recording a decision is not executing it.

records.title: SSLS-FND-001 current-state SSOT candidate, commit-bound
records.classification_basis: A candidate record bound to a past commit. The evidence pipeline replaced declared-SHA comparison as the live mechanism.
records.access_note: Read only at its declared binding; it is not re-bound to HEAD by this work package.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Anchors the earliest machine-verified statement of current state in this repository.
records.boundary: Candidate status; never ratified as approved doctrine.

records.title: Prior repository and bootstrap artifacts named in WP-006 provenance
records.exact_locator: named in docs/wp-006/DRIVE_REPOSITORY_AUTHORITY_MAP.md and docs/wp-006/REPOSITORY_CANDIDATE_COMPARISON.md; no reachable copy in this environment
records.classification_basis: DEC-010 records these as historical governance and evidence lineage that do not control current executable implementation, and requires any newly discovered prior repository to be inventoried and dispositioned before use.
records.access_note: No copy is present in this repository or reachable from this environment; only the WP-006 descriptions of them can be read.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Contents are unreachable, so usefulness for requirement recovery cannot be assessed without owner-supplied access.
records.boundary: Recorded as named, not as read. Nothing about their content is asserted.

records.title: Owner-supplied external Drive folder
records.classification_basis: Declared by the owner as part of the WP-007 source universe. No decision assigns it current authority, and its contents have not been inspected.
records.access_note: The executor has no credentialed access to this folder; no file listing, count, hash, or content claim is made.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Contents are unreachable, so usefulness cannot be assessed until the owner supplies exports into the repository or a reachable location.
records.boundary: Recorded by locator only. Nothing about its contents, completeness, or personal-data status is asserted, and ingestion is not authorized by this record.

records.title: Build prompt and execution prompt inputs supplied through the operator session
records.exact_locator: operator session inputs: Build Prompts 001-005 and the WP-037, WP-038 and WP-007 execution prompts
records.classification_basis: They originate the work packages, but only what was recorded into the repository registers carries authority; the session text itself is an input, not a record.
records.access_note: Recoverable through session history search only. Uploaded attachments are not retained as repository files and cannot be re-read at will.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Requirement wording that was summarized rather than recorded verbatim survives only here.
records.boundary: A prompt is not a decision. Nothing gains authority by having been requested.

records.title: Published preview and production surfaces
records.exact_locator: https://vision-trunk.lovable.app and the project preview URL
records.classification_basis: EV-020 classifies the published surface as PUBLIC PROTOTYPE; publication is not release authority and the deployed build is a projection of the repository.
records.access_note: Reachable as rendered output only; the deployed bundle is not a separate source of requirement text.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: It contains no requirement text that is not already in the repository.
records.boundary: Public prototype classification only. No release, district, or production claim.

records.title: Legacy SSLS 1.x application code
records.exact_locator: not present in this repository; referenced historically in docs/wp-006/IMPLEMENTATION_INVENTORY.md
records.classification_basis: The clean-slate posture carries no structures forward by default, and the WP-007 anti-targets forbid restoring legacy code. Refusal is recorded so the absence is deliberate rather than an oversight.
records.access_note: No copy is reachable, and none is sought under the current anti-targets.
records.recovery_relevance_reason: Unreachable and out of scope; requirement recovery from running code is not an authorized method in this cycle.
records.boundary: Refusal records a boundary, not a judgement about the quality or content of any prior implementation.
